Generate a Data Citation From Provenance

Source: R/lib_capsule.R
citecps.Rd

Builds a ready-to-paste data citation, as plain text and as a BibTeX @misc entry, from the dataset and resource blocks of a provenance record. Use it so that every report and paper built from a capsule cites the data set in the same words, with the retrieval date and licence that were actually pinned.

Usage

citecps(prov)

Arguments

prov

A provenance list as returned by loadprov(), or NULL.

Value

A list with text and bibtex, each a length-1 character string (the BibTeX entry has embedded newlines), or NULL if provenance is NULL.

Details

The fields used, with their fallbacks:

  • author: dataset$publisher, else "Unknown publisher";

  • title: resource$name, else dataset$package_slug, else "Untitled dataset";

  • year: the first four characters of captured_at_utc, else the current year; retrieval date: its first ten characters (omitted if absent);

  • link: https://doi.org/<dataset$doi> if a DOI is recorded, else resource$direct_url, else dataset$catalogue_page;

  • licence: dataset$licence_short, else dataset$licence_name.

The text form is Publisher (year). Title [Data set]. link Retrieved date. Licence: x. The BibTeX key is the package slug with non-alphanumeric characters removed, followed by the year. In the BibTeX entry the licence is written in the note field only when a retrieval date is present. No character in the fields is escaped for LaTeX. Error: prov that is not a list.

Examples

prov <- list(
  captured_at_utc = "2026-06-23T04:41:40Z",
  dataset = list(publisher = "Ontario Ministry of the Solicitor General",
                 licence_short = "OGL-Ontario",
                 package_slug = "data-on-inmates-in-ontario"),
  resource = list(name = "Restrictive Confinement - Detailed Dataset",
                  direct_url = "https://data.ontario.ca/example.csv")
)
cit <- citecps(prov)

# Plain-text citation ready to paste.
cat(cit$text)
#> Ontario Ministry of the Solicitor General (2026). Restrictive Confinement - Detailed Dataset [Data set]. https://data.ontario.ca/example.csv Retrieved 2026-06-23. Licence: OGL-Ontario.

# BibTeX @misc entry for LaTeX bibliographies.
cat(cit$bibtex)
#> @misc{dataoninmatesinontario2026,
#>   author = {{Ontario Ministry of the Solicitor General}},
#>   title = {Restrictive Confinement - Detailed Dataset},
#>   year = {2026},
#>   url = {https://data.ontario.ca/example.csv},
#>   note = {Retrieved 2026-06-23; licence: OGL-Ontario},
#> }

# a recorded DOI replaces the URL
prov$dataset$doi <- "10.5683/SP3/EXAMPLE"
cat(citecps(prov)$text)
#> Ontario Ministry of the Solicitor General (2026). Restrictive Confinement - Detailed Dataset [Data set]. https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/EXAMPLE Retrieved 2026-06-23. Licence: OGL-Ontario.

# NULL provenance returns NULL (composes safely).
citecps(NULL)
#> NULL

# anything else that is not a list is an error
try(citecps("data-on-inmates-in-ontario"))
#> Error : citecps: `prov` must be a provenance list (loadprov())
